what: On 9 Nov 2026, before the first push, the unpushed history of claude/semantic-goal-search-20261108 (and the merged claude/semantic-isaac-20261108) was rewritten only to remove Co-Authored-By trailers that named a model (AGENTS.md section 13). Abbreviated commit IDs inside commit messages were translated to the new IDs.
trees_identical: verified for every pair below: the old and new commit have the same tree, so the code at the new ID is byte-identical to the code that ran
where_old_ids_remain: experiments/configs/*.json frozen_commit fields and every file under results/ record the pre-rewrite IDs as they were written by the runs; they are not edited. Use this map.
